commands.name: askchoices
commands.description: Turn the ask_choices question tool on or off (no argument flips it). Off by default.

commands.description: Turn Session Panel on or off (no argument flips it), or pick the look: bars or list.

commands.name: progress
commands.description: Flip between the bar view and the list view.

commands.name: enhance
commands.description: Rewrite the prompt box, or /enhance <draft> to rewrite a draft given here.
commands.output: The box is empty. Type a draft first.

commands.name: enhance-key
commands.description: Add Ctrl+X E for Enhance to your keybindings.json.
commands.output: Added Ctrl+X E for Enhance. Restart the session if the key does nothing.

tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Session Panel: list the steps of the job in order, 1 to 8 short plain-English names starting with a verb (no paths, file names, commands or code). The first step starts at once. Call this first for every request.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Session Panel: report progress on a planned step by its name and a percent from 0 to 100. Use 100 the moment the step is finished.

tools.name: ask_choices
tools.description: Off by default: use AskUserQuestion to ask the person. Call this only if the person has said they turned on ask_choices. When on: ask a question with 2 to 4 options, the recommended option first, then stop and wait for their reply.
